name: How long does a water heater code upgrade typically add to the replacement process?

mainEntity.name: How long does a water heater code upgrade typically add to the replacement process?

acceptedAnswer.text: A water heater code upgrade can add several hours to the overall replacement timeline, depending on the number and complexity of the required updates. Simple upgrades like seismic strapping or minor T&P valve adjustments might add an hour or two. More involved changes, such as re-routing venting or installing new drain lines, could extend the process significantly. We strive to complete installations efficiently while ensuring all code requirements are met.
acceptedAnswer.description: Code upgrades can add several hours to the replacement, depending on the complexity of updates like venting or drain line changes.
